title: Container Bookings: Amount Limits for Goodwill on a Roll Fee Entry
content:
In Container Bookings, goodwill on a customer roll fee entry is bounded by the size of that entry.

## Rule

The customer roll fee entry addressed must have an amount greater than 0.00, and its amount must not exceed the largest single fee entry that the desk may waive under the product of the booking. An entry of 0.00 offers nothing to waive; an entry above the product's limit is beyond what the desk may cancel as goodwill.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical limit of 250.00)

| Amount of the fee entry | Within the limit? |
|---|---|
| 0.00 | no |
| 0.01 | yes |
| 250.00 | yes |
| 250.01 | no |

## Points of judgement

- **Which product's limit?** The limit of the product under which the booking carrying the entry is held.
- **Is the limit compared with the whole entry or with part of it?** With the whole entry; a waiver never covers only a portion of an entry, so an entry above the limit cannot be brought within it by waiving less.

The limit of 250.00 used above is an illustrative input.
